messageRisk.levelLow: No signs found by the rule set
messageRisk.note: This is only a rule-based check for warning signs; it doesn't prove a link or message is safe. Never enter an OTP or password on a page opened from a message; contact the organization through a channel you find yourself.
messageRisk.title: Content to check
messageRisk.linkPlaceholder: Paste the link — no need to open it…
messageRisk.privacy: Content is analyzed on your device; the tool never visits the link you paste.

flags.ipHost: Uses an IP address instead of a domain name.
flags.punycode: The domain uses punycode; compare it with the real name.
flags.shortener: A shortened link hides the destination.
flags.riskyTld: Domain ending commonly seen in risky links.
flags.fakeGov: Contains "gov" but isn't under the .gov.vn domain.
flags.brand: The domain contains "{{brand}}"; compare it with the official address.
flags.loginPath: The path suggests a login or verification step.
flags.otp: Asks for an OTP or verification code.
flags.lockThreat: Pressures you with a threat of account lockout.
flags.easyJob: Offers easy, high-paying work or online tasks.
flags.urgentTransfer: Urges you to transfer or top up money quickly.
flags.installApp: Asks you to install an app from the message.
